roadmap.goal: Story #6307: a connection save that changes its Additional Fields starts, at once and on every licence, an update of every Team and Portfolio on that connection, through the existing queue, Teams first; the edit page asks before it does so, with counts in the configured Terminology, and offers Save only. Slice 01 (backend only) lifts the connection's share of the fetch fingerprint into one function behind the already-committed pinned-digest test, publishes ConnectionFetchShapeChanged from the connection PUT when that share moved, triggers each owner from a handler, honours ?startUpdates=true|false, and answers 200 for a stored save whatever happens after it. Slice 02 puts usedBy { teams, portfolios } on the connection list read through a read-only connection-usage port, and asks `Update {n} {Teams} and {m} {Portfolios}?` with Cancel and Save and update, removing the 'next refresh of data' alert. Slice 03 adds Save only (startUpdates=false) and the usage-data event WorkTrackingSystemFieldsChanged = 19 carrying Updates: Now | Later. Done when every DISTILL row (1.1-1.22, 2.1-2.16, 3.1-3.12) is un-ignored or un-skipped and green; no `[Ignore(Pending)]` remains under API/Integration/ConnectionFieldChange/ or in WorkTrackingSystemFieldsChangedUsageEventTests.cs and no `it.skip` remains in EditConnection.fieldChange.test.tsx or the story-6307 block of WorkTrackingSystemService.test.ts; `dotnet build` has zero warnings (the NU1903 advisory on Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR.Common predates this story and is out of scope); the backend suite is green with `--filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"`; `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` are green with zero warnings. Docs prose (configuration.md, jira.md, azuredevops.md), the release-notes line, screenshots (N/A per DISTILL), the evolution record and Stryker belong to finalize after the maintainer's hold and are NOT steps here; the one exception is the docs/settings/usagedata.md row, which CLAUDE.md requires in the DELIVER step that adds the event (03-02).
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply, deliberately. The backend is C# + NUnit 4.6 + Moq + WebApplicationFactory, the frontend TypeScript + Vitest + RTL; the project references no property-testing library. DISTILL authored every acceptance test, example-based, with the finite axes as [TestCase] / it.each (feature-delta.md, DISTILL 'Mandates that do not apply here'). The crafter authors no new acceptance test: RED is removing [Ignore(Pending)] / it.skip and watching the test fail as distill/red-classification.md records (every pending test failed on an assertion, none on an error, all MISSING_FUNCTIONALITY); GREEN is production code. The only tests the crafter writes are the inner-loop unit and structural tests DESIGN and ADR-239 assign to DELIVER and name per step (ForConnection cases and the FetchShapingPropertyGuardTest connection subset in 01-01, the handler unit test in 01-02, the stored-save-answers-200 controller test and the only-the-PUT-publishes structural test in 01-04); the agreement between For and ForConnection that ADR-239 calls property-based is written as enumerated [TestCase] edits, for the same reason. Existing tests are edited only where DISTILL's Existing-test disposition says so, plus the mechanical constructor-arity and vocabulary edits each step lists by name (see the doubts recorded in implementation_notes of 01-02, 02-01 and 03-02), plus one deletion the orchestrator approved (the 3.9 case expecting a lowercase 'now' to be refused, 03-02), in the same commit as the change that makes them wrong. Steps that touch more than one test file list them all in test_files; test_file names the primary one.
exit_gates: End of every phase: the backend suite is green with `dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"` (exactly 2 Licensing failures in a git worktree are the gitignored licence fixture, not a regression); `dotnet build` zero warnings apart from the pre-existing NU1903. End of phases 02 and 03 additionally: `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` green with zero warnings (`pnpm build` runs `biome check --write` as prebuild, so run `pnpm exec biome check ./src` read-only first).

Before any push: `cd Lighthouse.Backend && dotnet format analyzers Lighthouse.sln --severity info --verify-no-changes --no-restore`, filtered to the union of `git diff --name-only <base>` and `git status --porcelain` (new files are invisible to git diff), with zero findings in a touched or new file.

Program.cs is edited in 01-02 (handler registration) and 02-01 (connection-usage registration): CI therefore runs the FULL backend Integration suite, including the live Jira, ADO, Linear, ServiceNow and GitHub categories. Expect the longer run; a GitHub rate-limit or connector-quota red there is not this change, and a red backend job skips sonar-gates, so re-run rather than assume the gate judged the push.

End of phase 01 (slice 01 dogfood and its hypotheses): on the dev instance (:5169, real history) add a field to a connection and watch the Task Manager rows clear within one scheduled round; rotate the token and check nothing starts. Record in the evolution record.

End of phase 02: start the backend once on the Postgres provider and read GET /api/latest/worktrackingsystemconnections, recording the usedBy counts per connection (DISTILL waived Postgres for the acceptance host and assigned this one check to DELIVER). No new fetch is added by the question, so there is no new loading or could-not-load look to check under a throttled connection (S4).

Ratification at the hold before any push: ADR-239 is still 'Proposed'; the three AFK decisions (a zero count keeps its place in the title, a refused save sends no usage event, the event lives in slice 03); whether the question stays inside ModifyConnectionSettings.tsx or becomes a sibling component; the existing-test edits outside DISTILL's disposition listed in 01-02, 02-01 and 03-02.

Phase 03 push: never push 03-02 without 03-03. 03-02 adds the server-side event and the usagedata.md row and 03-03 is where the browser first sends the event, so the two go out in one push: the page never describes an event nothing sends, and CLAUDE.md's emit-and-list-together rule holds.

Comments in new code: rare, plain-language why, never an internal reference (no D-, DDD-, S-, UC-, AC- or ADR- numbers). The one narrow suppression, `#pragma warning disable CA1031` in 01-04, carries its plain-language reason inline.

Pre-apply from docs/ci-learnings.md: (1) [FromQuery] parameters are required by default under nullable-enabled C# - give startUpdates a default of true so absent means true, and let binding refuse a non-boolean with 400 before the merge; (2) S3776 - the PUT action is near the cognitive-complexity limit, put the before/after compare, lookup and publish in a private helper rather than more branches in the action; (3) S107 - the controller goes from 5 to 6 parameters (01-04 takes it to 7, the limit); (4) render the 'before' share as the very first act in the callback, before Name, AuthenticationMethodKey, MergeOptions or the field merge touch the tracked entity, and publish only after Save() actually ran (the validation and licence refusals return before it, the 409 throws out of it); (5) the handler calls TriggerUpdate for every id unconditionally - never pre-check the queue or treat an already-admitted key as covered (the 2026-07-27 coalescing rule), never resolve services through GetRequiredService (DomainEventDispatcherSeamArchUnitTest), never catch and rethrow (S2139: the dispatcher already logs), writes nothing; (6) S6667 - any logger call in a catch passes the exception first; (7) handler test: build the Moq doubles per test in [SetUp] so a Times.Never can fail, CA1859/CA1861/NUnit2045/NUnit1028. Plain-language comment wanted on why Teams go first: a Portfolio updating in the same round then forecasts over Team data that already carries the field; no internal references. phases.description: Releasable alone on top of slice 01: the list read carries usedBy, and pressing Save on an existing connection whose Additional Fields differ from those loaded, after validation passed and with at least one Team or Portfolio on it, asks `Update {n} {Teams} and {m} {Portfolios}?` with Cancel and Save and update (focused). steps.name: The connection list says who uses each connection, and the page asks how many it will update
